name: @coding-adventures/visicalc-electron
description: Electron desktop wrapper around the Mosaic VisiCalc React demo. Demonstrates that the same Mosaic .mil/.mll/.msl sources that drive the web React build can power a native-windowed desktop app via Electron, with no host-code duplication.

scripts.build:react: cd ../visicalc && npm install --silent && npm run components && npx vite build --base ./
